opportunities.name: Ryanair flight search
opportunities.description: Search Ryanair one-way/return flights from an origin to a destination on given dates, then select fares (optionally apply a promo code).
steps: Enter or pick destination (To), via country then city or typing
Open date picker and choose month and day(s)
Click Select on outbound and return fares
